page.layout: One printed page. Title "INDEX" and subtitle centred at the top. Below them two columns of Hebrew headwords with page numbers, separated by a vertical rule. Under the columns, a signature at centre-left and a catchword at right.

main_text.head: INDEX
main_text.p: Vocum & regularum Ebraicarum*, quæ hoc codice explicantur.

page.notes: The Hebrew headwords are copied from a small, faint scan; many letters are uncertain and may be misread, though I have not marked each with [?]. The section letters ה, ב and ג are Hebrew letters as printed. The asterisk after "Ebraicarum" is a printed reference mark. The catchword "ד דין" is at the bottom right, and "Sf 2" is the signature at the bottom centre-left.
